name: Sinh nhật nàng
notes: A birthday for her on a city rooftop, from dusk into night (the shared woman, templates/_models/girl.glb, alone, fitted at H .32). The rooftop is set.js: a wooden deck and a parapet, a painted city behind (a dusk sky with a night sky fading in over it, towers whose windows light up, a moon and stars), the stairwell's hut with its door, string lights on three poles, potted plants, a little round table. 1 Hẹn trên sân thượng: the door opens, she walks out past the sign at the stairs (slot stairs, a polaroid taped on top), looks around while the string lights come on bulb by bulb, three polaroids on them lighting up with their bulbs. 2 Bóng bay kỷ niệm: six clear balloons rise from behind the parapet, a photo inside each turning to face the phone; she looks up, claps, spins. 3 Điều ước: a cake appears, its five candles light one by one; she clasps her hands to wish (the wish card, slot wish), leans in and blows them out in a puff of sparkles; one trick candle lights again (Ơ?!) and she blows harder. 4 Tuổi mới rực rỡ: small fireworks over the city, three more polaroids come down on the string lights between the first three, the banner (slot banner) rises under the first photo in a heart frame; she cheers and blows a kiss. Photos on fifteen surfaces: six balloons, six polaroids on the string lights, a big frame leaning on the parapet, the polaroid on the sign, the heart (always the first photo). A tap on her: a hop and hearts. The moves are story.js; the act is templates/_acts/lovestory.js.
